selection_rule: Same player-game as the existing prepared studies (test split, 1800-2199, >= 28 eligible decisions, baseline z(top-1) closest to the group median). Not selected on any model output.
featured_rule: In the selective study, the substituted engine-best move that Maia-3 5M ranks lowest (existing rule).

R.label: Regan-inspired reconstruction
R.outputs: projected P(top-1 engine match), P(top-3), difficulty, expected loss per decision; z(top-1) per game

prompt.eval_rule: clip(cp, -1000, 1000) / 100, formatted %+.2f; moves outside MultiPV -> n/a
